template: Resident Protections Ordinance relocation for demolition of Protected Units for new construction applies to this address. Source: LA Resident Protections Ordinance, Ordinances #188481 and #188482; LAMC 165.03.I(1); LAMC 151.22-151.28; Cal. Gov. Code 66300 et seq., 66300.6(b)(4)(A); as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
rewrite: At this address, the Resident Protections Ordinance's relocation rules apply when Protected Units are demolished to make way for new construction. Source: LA Resident Protections Ordinance, Ordinances #188481 and #188482; LAMC 165.03.I(1); LAMC 151.22-151.28; Cal. Gov. Code 66300 et seq., 66300.6(b)(4)(A); as of 2025-12-31. Not legal advice.
